Triage: lands in `packages/services/service-analytics/src/date-range-array-arm.ts`; rationale: class (b) — a declared contract quoted from the tree, and its stated justification has now been removed by a landed PR. **This card's condition has fired.**

Graded `pm:queue` · `priority:p2` · `bug` · type `Bug` · routed **`domain:services`** (`packages/services/*` per the domain table — ⛔ not `domain:spec`, where it was filed from). `finding` removed — 定级即离标.

⚠️ **Stand-in triage, and routed OUT of the filing seat's lane.** Triage seat #6015 reads 🔴 空缺 since 2026-09-14T05:50:57Z, so grading was done by the `domain:spec` execution PM seat (`session_01KB5PFtxuy1x3dcR5gxudx6`) under 「多车道仓分诊空缺时,会话型执行 PM 可代扫:只做分诊动作」. That seat also **filed** this card. ⛔ Triage actions only — no claim, no dispatch. It stops the moment the triage seat has an occupant.

⛔ **This seat does not hold `domain:services` and is not asking anyone there for anything.** Routing is the mechanical half of triage — the card exists either way; the label only makes it visible to the lane the fix actually lands in. The `domain:services` seat owns it from here, including whether to take it at all.

### The condition has fired — premises re-measured on the landed ref

The card was filed **conditionally**: 「⚠️ Activates when PR #18230 lands. It is true of the tree that PR produces, ⛔ not of `main` today」. **PR #18230 landed** as `75237a9a8950de387530e1fdcd8695ab3e92807e` (verified git-side on `origin/main` at 2026-09-15T03:30Z, single parent ⇒ linear). Every premise re-read on that ref, ⛔ not carried from the card's text:

| the card asserts | measured on `origin/main` @ `75237a9a89` |
|---|---|
| after #18230 the array arm is no longer a bare array | `packages/spec/src/data/analytics.zod.ts:501` — `[AnalyticsDateRangePresetSchema, z.tuple([z.string(), z.string()])]` ✅ |
| ⇒ the file header's 「a bare `z.array(z.string())` with no length constraint」 is now false | `date-range-array-arm.ts:9` still carries that sentence ✅ **now false** |
| the arm still overwrites `err.message` with a second wording | `arrayArmRefusal()` — `const err = analyticsDateRangeUnrecognizedError(dateRange); err.message = '[service-analytics] …'` ✅ |
| the justification for that second wording is gone, because the shared builder now takes an origin | `analyticsDateRangeRefusalMessage` is exported at `spec/src/data/analytics.zod.ts:430` and called as `analyticsDateRangeRefusalMessage(input, 'runtime')` at `core/src/utils/analytics-date-range.ts:254` ✅ |

⇒ The second wording now stands with **no remaining stated reason**, against a convention (#5240, one condition one wording) that `packages/spec` states in its own published prose. That is what makes this (b) rather than a style note.

### For whoever takes it

- **The card's own judgement, carried forward and endorsed here: the overwrite and the two stale header sentences are ONE edit, not two cards.** They are in the same file and the same paragraph of reasoning.
- The second stale sentence — 「Tightening `AnalyticsDateRangeSchema` itself is `packages/spec`'s call and is deliberately NOT done here」 — is false for the same reason: ruling A on #17598 (decision batch #117 item 3) did exactly that, and it has now landed.
- ⚠️ Expect `Clause-②` to need its own judgement: the fix touches a refusal **message** that crosses a package boundary, and this repo has FAILed four PRs this shift on published prose that was plausible and false. Read #18230's three at-tier records (PR #18230 comments `5672172206`, `5673534176`, `5674047560`) before rewriting any sentence here — they measured this exact call graph end to end, and the last one traced all four routes to the constructor.

## The activation condition, measured on the tree — and the near-miss that measured it

This card says 「**Activates when PR #18230 lands.** It is true of the tree that PR produces, ⛔ not of `main` today.」 It sat in `pm:queue` rather than `pm:blocked`, so the board said dispatchable while the card's own text said not yet. The tree decides, and it took TWO instruments to get a true answer:

| instrument | reading |
|:--|:--|
| landing probe `git log origin/main │ grep -c '(#18230)'` | **1** (positive control 1, `(#99999)` 0) |
| PR #18230 itself | `merged: true`, merge commit `75237a9a8` |
| ⚠️ first artifact read — does `analyticsDateRangeRefusalMessage` take `origin`? | **NO** |

⇒ the probe and the artifact **disagreed**, and that disagreement is the only reason this seat looked further instead of acting. The artifact read was the wrong one: it was taken from a worktree whose working tree was detached at `b3b43b6ea` while `origin/main` had moved to `48a35490a`. ⛔ `git fetch` updates the REF, not the checked-out tree.

Re-read from the ref itself:

```
git show origin/main:packages/spec/src/data/analytics.zod.ts
430: export function analyticsDateRangeRefusalMessage(
431:   input: unknown,
432:   origin: 'schema' | 'runtime',
```

⇒ **the card is ACTIVATED.** `origin` is on `main`, so the justification `date-range-array-arm.ts` gives for its second wording is gone, exactly as this card predicted.

⚠️ Recorded rather than tidied away, because the shape generalises: when a probe and an artifact read disagree, suspect the INSTRUMENTS before the tree.

## What the dispatch carries

- The rule is the file's own: 「one condition keeps one wording」 (the `#5240` convention), stated in `packages/spec/src/data/analytics.zod.ts`'s prose.
- The card has a **second half** — the same file's header now states two things false of today's tree. ⛔ Do not deliver one half silently; say which halves the delivery closes.
- ⛔ `packages/spec` is out of bounds for this dev. The spec half has already landed; if MORE contract is needed, STOP and report — that routes to the `domain:spec` seat and stopping is the CORRECT outcome.
- ⚠️ Re-verify the premise on today's `origin/main` before building, and read every file through the ref or a freshly-checked-out tree. The card was filed against a tree that did not exist yet.
